name: toffoli
description: CCX with its controls in descending order, on a basis input, measured.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(3, 3)
qc.x(0)
qc.x(2)
qc.ccx(2, 0, 1)
qc.measure(0, 0)
qc.measure(1, 1)
qc.measure(2, 2)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(3)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.X(q[0]),
    cirq.X(q[2]),
    cirq.CCX(q[2], q[0], q[1]),
    cirq.measure(q[0], key="c0"),
    cirq.measure(q[1], key="c1"),
    cirq.measure(q[2], key="c2"),
)
